heading: More windows, an SFTP filter, and a tidier toolbar
summary: Open more than one window, filter the SFTP folder on screen, and choose which panel buttons show.
changes: File → New Window (⌘⇧N) opens another window with its own tabs.
Press ⌘F in an SFTP panel to show only the names that match, such as *.log.
Right-click a panel's title bar or use More → Customize Toolbar to pick and order its buttons.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
